user.title: Heliotherm Heat Pump Setup
user.description: Configure your Heliotherm heat pump connection.

data_description.host: IP address/hostname (TCP) or device path (Serial, e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3)
data_description.port: TCP port number (default: 9999) or serial baud rate (default: 115200)
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for data (in seconds)

write_protection.title: Allow changes to heat pump settings

data_description.write_enabled: Check to allow changing heat pump settings

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the heat pump. Please check the host, port, and network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured.

init.title: Ht HA Options
init.description: Configure the displayed model, polling interval, and exposed parameters. The model is entered manually, not detected from the heat pump.

data_description.selected_params: Select the parameters you want to expose as entities
data_description.model: Enter the model from the nameplate. Leave blank to display Heat Pump. This only changes device details.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read heat pump data, in seconds.
data_description.curve_reference_upper: Comparison only, e.g. for radiators. Factory: 22/27/30 °C. Fixed htha floor-heating heuristics still apply.
data_description.curve_reference_zero: Comparison only, e.g. for radiators. Factory: 22/27/30 °C. Fixed htha floor-heating heuristics still apply.
data_description.curve_reference_lower: Comparison only, e.g. for radiators. Factory: 22/27/30 °C. Fixed htha floor-heating heuristics still apply.

load_time_program_profile.description: Copy user profile or read-only factory preset into draft and clear approvals. Factory presets require loaded metadata for the selected program and resolve only verified mode mappings. Apply profile shortcut must then fresh-validate, review diff/warnings and explicitly confirm through apply_time_program.

read_only.description: Load without a compatible baseline for numeric editing only. Fresh validation still required.

set_time_program_mode_mapping.name: Confirm numeric mode mapping
set_time_program_mode_mapping.description: Persist display mapping bound to program metadata, controller and firmware. Invalidates approval, never translates numeric codes or writes to pump.

mapping.name: Numeric-to-semantic mapping
mapping.description: Optional override; omit to use the verified firmware 2.03N default. Exactly keys 0..nos-1. Heating: 0 setback, 1 normal, 2 boost. DHW: 0 minimum (Off), 1 charging (On). Null remains unverified. Numeric payloads are never translated.

confirmed.name: Confirm controller mapping
confirmed.description: True only after explicitly verifying these codes on this controller and firmware.

start_time_program_draft.name: Start schedule draft
start_time_program_draft.description: Explicitly copy the current schedule or a profile against the pump baseline. Never writes to the pump.

discard_time_program_draft.name: Discard schedule draft
discard_time_program_draft.description: Close the shared draft with revision and session checks. Never writes to the pump.

editor_conflict.message: The editor changed in another tab or session. Refresh and validate again.

mapping_conflict.message: Mode mapping revision changed. Reload and confirm again.

mapping_invalid.message: Explicitly confirm a unique supported semantic mapping with exactly the native numeric choices.

profile_conflict.message: Profile revision changed or confirmation is missing. Reload the library.

profile_incompatible.message: Profile category, metadata or baseline is incompatible. Use read-only preview, refresh and review.

profile_missing.message: Profile not found in this integration entry.

profile_category.message: Profile category/program must match the selected loaded program.

profile_duplicate.message: A profile with this name already exists in this category. Explicitly update its UUID or use a different name.

profile_name.message: Use a plain-text profile name of 1–80 characters without control characters.

profile_description.message: Description must be plain text with at most 1000 characters.

draft_shape.message: Use seven fully covered days, at most 96 ordered quarter-hour runs/day, integer numeric states and no unknown cells.

payload_too_large.message: Schedule request exceeds the 70 KB limit.

library_corrupt.message: Profile Store is corrupt or unsupported. Repair from a backup; no approvals were restored.

baseline_unavailable.message: Load a compatible program baseline first.

profile_read_only.message: The built-in factory preset is read-only. Use Save as to create your own copy.

schedule_recovery.title: Schedule recovery required
schedule_recovery.description: An apply for {entry} failed or was interrupted. Refresh the baseline while keeping the draft, inspect actual_program and previous_program, then check and acknowledge the previous program before a confirmed restore. No automatic restore is performed.

schedule_profiles.title: Repair schedule profile library
schedule_profiles.description: The profile library for {entry} is corrupt or has an unsupported version. Repair the Store from a verified backup. Recovery evidence is separate; no write approvals were loaded.
